name: HeSays_3
short_caption: The robot lifts and opens its right hand slightly forward and to the side as if introducing an idea, then returns to neutral.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture. It raises its right arm, bending the elbow and bringing the hand up towards chest level before extending it slightly forward and outward with an open, palm-up hand gesture. The head tracks slightly to the right to follow the movement, and the robot then smoothly lowers its arm and returns its head to the central, neutral position.
